Color Bends by David Haz / React Bits.
Source: https://reactbits.dev/backgrounds/color-bends
Registry: https://reactbits.dev/r/ColorBends-JS-CSS.json
Original Color Bends flow geometry hosted with native WebGL for this buildless local preview.
Local light-surface adaptation: coverage is remapped to purple ink alpha with a narrow core and soft halo; RGB is correctly premultiplied, avoiding gray shadows on white. Original unmodified JSX is retained alongside this file.
Official Demo defaults: one #A855F7 color, rotation 90, scale/frequency/warpStrength/iterations 1, speed .2, noise .15, intensity 1.5, bandWidth 6.
The reference pointer influence/parallax defaults are preserved, with pointer fixed at center for hands-off phone startup.
See LICENSE.md (MIT + Commons Clause).

Portrait composition retains the reference 750:598 shader field while the canvas still fills the real phone screen.
